label: For "Healthcare Procurement Spend Anomaly Detection": Identify unusual purchasing amounts, frequency, unit prices, suppliers, categories and cost-centre patterns, and give procurement and finance a ranked exception queue with the expected-versus-actual variance and the evidence behind it. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Comparing unnormalised units.
